name: stm32-async-1wire
description: Non-blocking 1-Wire master for STM32 with DS18B20 temperature and DS2431 EEPROM drivers. Uses TIM1+DMA for hardware-automated bus timing — the CPU never performs timing-critical busy-waits inside a transaction.
keywords: 1wire, ds18b20, ds2431, onewire, stm32, temperature, eeprom, non-blocking, dma, bare-metal
